title: 5,000 years old Egyptian iron beads made from hammered meteoritic iron
version: Journal of Archaeological Science 40, 4785–4792; open-access publisher PDF
lineage: Original non-destructive analysis of three museum beads, linked to excavation records. No direct inheritance claim to later smelting is adopted.

passages.note: Inspected abstract, sealed-burial dating, specimen selection and manufacturing interpretation; punctuation normalized in short excerpt.
